about: Hot dog avatar requested 2026-10-18: the sausage and the bun flop together now and then, and the condiments spill off onto the desk. The sausage sticking out of the top is the app's floppy tip; mustard, ketchup and relish come off as mess in the app. Same rules as demo-avatars-01..06: no Tripo rig, no brands or text, faceless (the app adds the face).
style: Fun, charming cartoon style like a polished stylized 3D game asset: smooth chunky shapes, bold readable silhouette, appealing saturated colours.

props.subject: a hot dog standing upright on one end, seen straight from the front and symmetrical: a plump juicy red-brown sausage runs straight up the middle, hugged on the left and right by the two soft golden-brown halves of the bun; the sausage is much longer than the bun and sticks well out of the top (about a third of its length) with a rounded end; a thick wavy yellow mustard zigzag and a red ketchup squiggle sit only on the part of the sausage above the bun and drip a little over the top edges of the bun, with a few chunky green relish bits up there; the middle and lower front of the sausage between the bun halves is plain and smooth with nothing on it; flat bottom, no feet, no legs, standing directly on nothing (no plate, no stand, no platform, no base under the bun)
